title: Tools, Not Clicks
subtitle: Building Agent-Ready Websites with WebMCP
author: Maxim Salnikov
tested_with: Tested with Chrome {chrome_version} and the WebMCP draft of {spec_date}
description: A practical book on WebMCP, the proposed web standard that lets a website give AI agents real, typed tools instead of making them click through the page.
tagline: WebMCP lets a page hand the browser's agent real tools: named, described, schema-typed functions it calls directly, inside the user's own session, with the user watching and in control.

The APIs and code in this book were checked against the WebMCP specification (Draft Community Group Report of {spec_date}) and tested with Chrome {chrome_version}, except where the text marks them as unverified. WebMCP is an early proposal and it changes; check the specification and the Chrome documentation for later changes.
